motivo: there is text before the first section («## Name»)
queHacer: Delete that text or move it inside a section; only the `# ` title can go before.

motivo: the guide has no sections («## Name»)
queHacer: Add at least one section that starts with `## `.

motivo: the guide has more than 60 sections
queHacer: Merge similar screens until you have 60 or fewer.
Add that label with text to section X (the reported line is the `## X` one).

motivo: the label … is repeated in the section
queHacer: Keep the label only once in that section.

motivo: text in the section that doesn't belong to any label
queHacer: Put a label before that text, or delete it.

motivo: common problems go with «- » at the start of each line

queHacer: Shorten the text of that line.

motivo: a common problem is over 300 characters
queHacer: Shorten the text of that line.

motivo: at most 10 common problems per section

queHacer: Write the problem after «- » or delete the line.

motivo: «Where:» must be a path that starts with /
queHacer: Write a real route of the app, like `/settings/billing`, or delete the line.

motivo: the guide doesn't have the expected shape
queHacer: Check the whole format against the example.
